claude-code.note: Claude's native names are the envelope's vocabulary as-is

sprig.note: names translated by sprig's DaisugiGate before they reach us. See docs/harness/harness-comparison.md

codex.note: codex reads through shell. apply_patch is its only write tool. See src/opendaisugi/parsers/codex.py

pi.note: pi's built-in names are lowercase and its file tools take path. The extension sends them as tool_name and tool_input with --format pi. See src/opendaisugi/harness_pi/extension/PINS.md and _PI_TOOL_TYPE_MAP in src/opendaisugi/hook.py

opencode.note: vocabulary not pinned in this corpus
